title: Weekly sync — serving-runtime / infra / console agenda (2026-03-11)
body:
Purpose: Align infra/serving-runtime/console priorities for the week, surface blockers for rollouts, and track action items. Goal: keep this meeting to 45 minutes; escalate any long discussions to follow-up breakout sessions.

Meeting logistics:
- Date/Time: 2026-03-11, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Attendees (required): Alex Chen (owner), Sofia Martinez, Maya Patel, Daniel Kim. Optional: Priya Singh, Ethan Ross.
- Where: #eng-serving-runtime Zoom (link in calendar).

Pre-meeting asks (please update JIRA/PR status before join):
- PMs: update rollout readiness checklist in JIRA-1287.
- Infra: post capacity forecast spreadsheet (link above) with updated GPU pool targets.
- Console: confirm feature flag gating plan for rollout.

Agenda (timeboxed):
1) 5m — Quick rundowns (round-robin, 1 min each)
   - Top priority for this week (prod impact / blocked items)
   - Any escalations required?

2) 10m — Rollout status: v2.4 kernel selection + canary (Sofia)
   - Current canary: 10% traffic on us-west clusters; latency P95 has improved ~8% vs baseline.
   - Open risks: KV cache warm-up causes transient 200–400ms tail spikes after cold start (see incident notes).
   - Decision needed: keep canary at 10% and extend warm-up, or rollback to 5%.

3) 10m — Infra capacity & autoscaling (Daniel)
   - Reserved pools: projected shortfall for weekend traffic spike if burst not enabled.
   - Request: approve temporary burst capacity for sat–sun (estimate +6 A100 nodes).
   - Action: if approved, infra to provision and run smoke tests.

4) 8m — Console metrics + tracing improvements (Maya)
   - Dashboard changes: token-level cost breakdown on per-route view (PR ready).
   - UX ask: add ability to filter traces by model-variant; will require small API change.

5) 7m — Incidents & postmortem follow-ups (Priya)
   - Last week incident (JIRA-1234): root cause = kernel selection mismatch on long-context models.
   - Mitigation implemented: pin model-kernel combo + fallback policy. Need to verify during next business hours.

6) 5m — AOB / parking lot & sync up on action items

Notes / context (short):
- Perf numbers: P50 stable, P95 improved in canary. Memory fragmentation observed in edge worker nodes; Infra is testing new GC tuning.
- Console PRs: console#302 adds trace filters; depends on runtime PR 458 for trace tags.
- Related tickets to review before meeting: JIRA-1287 (rollout readiness), JIRA-1310 (KV cache warm-up investigation).

Action items (tracking) — assigned during meeting, update status in this doc after meeting. Format: [owner] - task - due date - status.
- [Sofia Martinez] - Decide on canary percent for v2.4 kernel selection and post decision in JIRA-1287 - 2026-03-12 - open
- [Daniel Kim] - Provision temporary burst + run smoke tests if canary decision requires capacity; report results - 2026-03-13 - open
- [Maya Patel] - Merge console PR #302 after adding model-variant filter; coordinate with runtime team to ensure tags present - 2026-03-12 - open
- [Priya Singh] - Verify mitigation for JIRA-1234 on prod canary and close verification checklist - 2026-03-12 - open
- [Alex Chen] - Coordinate postmortem doc & finalize mitigation timeline; add follow-up owners - 2026-03-14 - open
- [Ethan Ross] - Experiment: run GC tuning on 3 edge worker nodes and provide perf comparison (before/after) - 2026-03-15 - open

Parking lot (items to take offline):
- Long discussion about kernel auto-selection heuristics (schedule separate deep-dive).
- Proposal for automated rollback policy based on combined latency + error-rate signals (SLOv2) — needs design doc.

Last meeting quick follow-ups (status):
- Daniel: capacity plan uploaded — DONE (see linked spreadsheet).
- Sofia: canary rollout started — IN PROGRESS (10% as of 2026-03-03).
- Maya: dashboard mockups shared — IN REVIEW.

Prep notes to self (Alex):
- Bring specific P95 numbers and the slow trace examples for the canary cluster.
- Push for decision on canary percent (we need runway to provision burst capacity).
- If rollback is chosen, prioritize timeline and customer-impact comms.

Post-meeting protocol (please):
- Owner of each action item to update this doc and the corresponding JIRA before EOD on their due date.
- If action falls behind, owner to flag via Slack #eng-serving-runtime and request support.

References / helpful links:
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SERV/serving-runtime-weekly
- Rollout readiness: JIRA-1287
- Incident: JIRA-1234
- Runtime PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/458
- Console PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/302

-- end of agenda draft --

(Will iterate after any pre-meeting updates; keep this doc as the single source of truth for the meeting and action-item tracking.)
